_readme: Source for favcircles.com/widgets.html. Edit here, then run: node website/tools/build-widgets-page.js — and upload widgets.html (see the website SFTP notes). Keep in step with the favcircles-widgets registry: every widget in FavWidgetRegistry.all appears here, new features get a line.

widgets.name: Events
widgets.tagline: Party bus, trip or night out: photos and videos only your group sees.
features: Start an event and drop one link in the group text, or invite friends in the app
A shared album of photos and videos only the people who joined can see, from the camera or your photo library
Video clips up to 15 seconds free (5 per event), or up to a minute with Premium
Download every photo and video of the night to your Photos in one tap, zoom in on any photo, and save or share a single clip
Tap anyone in the event to see their profile
Tag the places you went and save them to a circle named after the event
Roll call ("everyone here?") and photo challenges to keep the night fun
A FavCoin 🌵 for joining

widgets.name: Clubs
widgets.tagline: Run clubs, walk groups, book clubs: who's in, when you meet, and what's new.
features: Start a club (run, walk, ride, hike, swim, yoga, books or anything) and share one link to bring people in
Weekly meetups like "Saturdays 7 AM at the park", plus one-off events
Tap Going or Can't make it, see who's coming, and get a reminder an hour before
A bulletin for organizers' announcements, sent to every member as a notification
A message board where anyone can post, react and reply
Organizers and members: add co-organizers, remove people, close joining or reset the link
Mute a club anytime
A FavCoin 🌵 for joining

widgets.name: How Are You?
widgets.tagline: Check on Mom or Dad a few times a day.
features: Questions at the times you pick; they answer with one tap from the Lock Screen
Questions fit their life: pain from 0 to 10, meds, sleep, PT days, rides
A heads-up when an answer needs attention, or when they go quiet
Brothers and sisters can join the same check-in
Send love on any answer, and say "I'll call" so the family knows it's handled
Your parent sees their own week, trends and streaks too

widgets.name: Postcard
widgets.tagline: A real postcard from your trip photo.
features: Pick a photo and a design, add a note
Send it to a friend's chat, by email, or as a link anyone can open
Or have it printed and mailed anywhere in the US, with delivery updates

widgets.name: Fridge Mail
widgets.tagline: Kids' drawings, mailed to Grandma every week.
features: Snap the drawing; we print it and mail it
Send to up to three grandparents on a weekly schedule
Follow every card from the printer to Grandma's mailbox, and tap one to see it full size

widgets.name: Bill Split
widgets.tagline: Split the check and the tip in seconds.
features: Enter the bill, pick the tip, see what everyone owes
Tip on the pre-tax amount, and round up if you like
Share the split as a card in the group chat

widgets.name: NextBar
widgets.tagline: Your next bar, picked from where your friends actually go.
features: Picks a bar near you from your saved places and your friends'
Start a group vote and let everyone pick where to go next

widgets.name: What to Eat
widgets.tagline: Can't decide? One tap picks for you.
features: Spin for a craving and see where to get it nearby, starting with places you and your friends saved
Narrow it down: comfort, spicy, healthy, veggie, cheap eats or treat yourself
Not feeling it? Spin again

widgets.name: Make Me a Drink
widgets.tagline: A cocktail to order tonight, and how to make any classic.
features: Recipes for every spirit, with a surprise-me shake
Calories on every drink
Send a recipe to a friend's chat

widgets.name: Workouts
widgets.tagline: Log sets, reps and personal records.
features: Routines that remember last time's numbers
Cardio with calories, a rest timer and exercise photos
Share a workout with friends; they can copy it as their own routine
Let your Inner Circle see your whole workout history

widgets.name: FavRun
widgets.tagline: Track your runs on a map.
features: GPS route map, pace, splits and personal bests
Your run on the Lock Screen while you go
Share your runs with the friends you choose

widgets.name: Coach Mane
widgets.tagline: A coach who won't let you skip.
features: An animated coach with a fresh line every time: tough love, or savage if you dare
He'll remind you through the day; tap Did it to keep your streak
Send his line to a friend who needs to hear it

widgets.name: Water
widgets.tagline: One tap per glass.
features: A daily goal, streaks and a month at a glance
Reminders every 1 to 4 hours, and log a cup right from the notification

widgets.name: Habits
widgets.tagline: Daily check-ins and streaks.
features: One-tap check-ins for the habits you want to keep
Every day, or just the days you choose
Streaks and your best streak; retired habits keep their history

widgets.name: Calories
widgets.tagline: Quick-add meals and macros.
features: Log what you eat in a couple of taps
A daily calorie goal, plus macro goals if you want them
Recent foods one tap away, and your last 7 days at a glance

widgets.name: Heartbeat
widgets.tagline: Your pulse, from the camera or a strap.
features: Measure your heart rate with your phone's camera, or connect a Bluetooth heart-rate strap
A lens guide shows when your finger is steady
A reading in under 20 seconds

widgets.name: Medications
widgets.tagline: A reminder for every dose, and one tap to log it.
features: Add each medication with its dose and the times you take it
A reminder at each time; tap Took it right from the notification, or snooze 10 minutes
Today's doses at a glance, with anything missed flagged after two hours
How many doses you took over the last 7 days and this month
Private: only you see it

widgets.name: Sleep Score
widgets.tagline: How well you slept, scored every morning from Apple Health.
features: A nightly score out of 100 from how long you slept, time asleep in bed, consistency and sleep stages
Reads your sleep from Apple Health (your Apple Watch or any sleep app), or log a night by hand
Your recent nights at a glance, with 7-night averages
Private: your Health data stays on your phone

widgets.name: Weather
widgets.tagline: Right now, the next hours and 10 days.
features: The weather where you are, hour by hour and 10 days out
Save the cities you care about and swipe between them, like the Weather app
The temperature sits on the app's home screen too
Live rain radar around US places, like the Weather app

widgets.name: Stocks
widgets.tagline: Indexes, rates, crypto and the stocks you follow.
features: The Nasdaq, Dow and S&P at a glance, plus your own watchlist
Named lists you can reorder, with a chart for each day
The 10-year yield and Bitcoin right on the card

widgets.name: Quotes
widgets.tagline: Good lines at the times you pick.
features: Pick your topics and how many times a day
Share a quote with a friend

widgets.name: Sleep Sounds
widgets.tagline: Rain, ocean, fire: mix and drift off.
features: Real recordings of rain, thunder, ocean waves, a stream, wind, crickets, a campfire and a heartbeat, plus white, pink and brown noise and a fan
Mix sounds into your own blend
A timer that fades out gently, with controls on the Lock Screen
Works offline: the sounds are in the app

widgets.name: Parking
widgets.tagline: Remember where you parked.
features: Save your spot in one tap, with an optional photo and note (level, row, landmark)
Walking directions back to your car
A meter reminder before time runs out, and another when it expires
Private: the photo stays on your phone

widgets.name: Packages
widgets.tagline: Every tracking number in one place.
features: Paste or scan a shipping label; the carrier is detected for you (USPS, UPS, FedEx, Amazon, DHL, OnTrac)
Open each carrier's tracking page in a tap
A reminder the morning a package is expected
Private: only you see your packages

widgets.name: New Contacts
widgets.tagline: The last 50 people you added to your phone.
features: Newest first, so you can find the person you met last night without remembering their name
Call, text or open their contact card in a tap
Contacts added together are grouped as an import
Stays on your phone: nothing is uploaded
